resolution: Raised MAX_ORIENTED from 256 to 16384 (matching MAX_RECTS) in framework/game/physics.zig and PHYSICS_LIMITS.orientedRects in cart/hmsc-int/game/physics.ts. Root cause of the compiled-game walk-through-walls: the prop-physics refactor makes every prop bake a footprint collider on the ORIENTED lane; a real city reached ~300 oriented colliders, over the old 256 cap, so world_loader.zig:1039 silently clamped to 256 and dropped the tail (44 colliders) = pieces you walk through. The sibling MAX_RECTS had already been raised 4096->16384 for the identical bug; MAX_ORIENTED was left low. Only static buffer keyed to it is g_camera_occlusion_oriented_values (~850KB, free headroom; per-step cost is the actual count). game/physics suite 16/16 green. Needs a host rebuild (fresh rjit dev) + the loader rebuilds on rjit game play; no re-bake required. NOT committed (left in working tree).
